name: elevator
description: Elevator car — a room flagged flags.elevator whose flags.elevator_floors maps display floor numbers to destination zones on their own z-levels. `floor <n>` rides the car to that floor; a describeRoom panel shows the numbered floor buttons. Display numbers (e.g. 50+) are decoupled from the actual grid_z, so a tower can read as floor 50 without needing 50 z-levels.
